Volumetric water content is the ratio of the volume of water to the unit volume of soil.  It is expressed in cubic metres of water per cubic metre of soil, or as a percentage.
Measurements are usually made with time-domain reflectometry, capacitance sensors or neutron probes, and depend on soil texture, bulk density and temperature. Values range from the residual water content to the saturated water content (porosity). Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-measurement-technique-without-spaces
